name: GitHub
changes: Its work journal is written one record at a time under a lock (the kit's storage.mjs), so the work processes of a repository and a workspace, which share its data folder, no longer write over each other's attempts.
description: Daoris's work on GitHub through its REST API, with the token its own login keeps: pull-request opens a GitHub pull request from the branch Daoris pushed and reads its state.

commands.name: login
commands.about: Keeps a GitHub token for its REST API in this plugin's own storage.

commands.name: status
commands.about: Says whether a token is kept, since when, and whether GitHub last refused it.

storage.for: The token login keeps, and when GitHub last refused it.

about.en: Opens a GitHub pull request from the branch Daoris pushed to origin, or finds the one already open for it. It sends nothing but its API calls, with the token its own login keeps.
about.zh: 从 Daoris 已推送到 origin 的分支创建 GitHub 拉取请求，已有未关闭的则直接沿用。只发送它的 API 请求，使用它自己登录时保存的令牌。

tools.for: Runs the plugin's plugin.mjs, and its calls to GitHub's REST API (fetch).
